input.rationale: Governing law already sits at our preferred position: Section 15.5 (p0627) applies New York law, as does the Letter (p0671), so no governing-law edit is needed. The forum fails both preferred and fallback: Section 15.6(a) commits every merits Dispute to mandatory JAMS arbitration with the seat and panel redacted, and no court forum (New York County, Delaware, California or London) is designated anywhere. The revised redline now cures this in operative language: Section 15.6(a) submits Disputes to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County; the residual arbitration machinery is struck in the text itself (the JAMS Expedited Procedures modifications and the binding-award/judgment-entry sentence in p0630, and Sections 15.6(b)-(e)); and the interim-relief carve-out in Section 15.6(j) is narrowed to temporary restraining orders, preliminary injunctions and other interim equitable relief pending resolution of a Dispute in the designated courts, removing the "prior to or during any arbitration" anchor. Unrelated commercial terms are preserved rather than deleted: the mutual punitive/exemplary damages waiver (15.6(f)), the performance and termination-stay mechanic (15.6(g)), the English-language requirement, and the subject-matter carve-outs for foreign patent/trademark validity (15.6(h)) and Program Invention ownership (15.6(i), with its cross-reference conformed to 15.6(a)).

mappings.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York without reference to any rules of conflict of laws.

mappings.element: State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere.

proposal.summary: Move the merits forum in Section 15.6 from JAMS arbitration (redacted seat) to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, and conform the residual arbitration machinery and the interim-relief carve-out in the operative text.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] New York law already governs, but the merits forum is JAMS arbitration in an undisclosed seat; our position requires the state and federal courts in New York County to have exclusive jurisdiction, subject only to interim injunctive relief elsewhere. We have replaced the arbitration referral in Section 15.6(a), removed the residual arbitration machinery in Section 15.6(b)-(e) and the JAMS/award text, and conformed Sections 15.6(f), (g), (i) and (j) so the punitive-damages waiver, the stay of termination and the interim-relief carve-out survive without reference to an arbitration that no longer exists.

The award shall be rendered within [***] of the constitution of the arbitral tribunal, unless the arbitrators determine that the interest of justice requires that such limit be extended.

The arbitrators may award to the prevailing Party, if any, as determined by the arbitrators, the costs and attorneys' fees reasonably incurred by the prevailing Party in connection with the arbitration. If the arbitrators determine a Party to be the prevailing Party under circumstances where the prevailing Party won some but not all of the claims and counterclaims, the arbitrators may award the prevailing Party an appropriate percentage of the costs and attorneys' fees reasonably incurred by the prevailing Party in connection with the arbitration.
